jude.1.p1.b1.text: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, …

jude.1.p1.b2.text: … To those who are called, loved by God the Father, and kept in Jesus Christ:

jude.1.p1.b3.text: Mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.

jude.1.p2.b1.text: Beloved, although I made every effort to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt it necessary to write and urge you …

jude.1.p2.b2.text: … to contend earnestly for the faith entrusted once for all to the saints.

jude.1.p2.b3.text: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed … They turn the grace of our God into a license for immorality, …

jude.1.p2.b4.text: … and they deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.

jude.1.p3.b1.text: … after Jesus had delivered His people out of the land of Egypt, He destroyed those who did not believe.

jude.1.p3.b2.text: Although you are fully aware of this, I want to remind you …

jude.1.p3.b3.text: And the angels who did not stay within their own domain but abandoned their proper dwelling—these He has kept in eternal chains under darkness, bound for judgment on that great day.

jude.1.p3.b4.text: In like manner, Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, … are on display as an example of those who sustain the punishment of eternal fire.

jude.1.p4.b1.text: Yet in the same way these dreamers defile their bodies, reject authority, and slander glorious beings.

jude.1.p4.b2.text: But even the archangel Michael, when he disputed with the devil over the body of Moses, did not presume to bring a slanderous charge against him, …

jude.1.p4.b4.text: These men, however, slander what they do not understand, … they will be destroyed by the things they do instinctively.

jude.1.p5.b2.text: … They have traveled the path of Cain; …

jude.1.p5.b3.text: … they have rushed headlong into the error of Balaam; …

jude.1.p5.b4.text: … they have perished in Korah’s rebellion.

jude.1.p6.b1.text: These men are hidden reefs in your love feasts, shamelessly feasting with you …

jude.1.p6.b3.text: … They are clouds without water, carried along by the wind; fruitless trees in autumn, twice dead after being uprooted.

jude.1.p6.b4.text: They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.

jude.1.p7.b1.text: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, also prophesied about them: …

jude.1.p7.b2.text: … “Behold, the Lord is coming with myriads of His holy ones to execute judgment on everyone, …

jude.1.p7.b3.text: These men are discontented grumblers, … their mouths spew arrogance; they flatter others for their own advantage.

jude.1.p8.b1.text: These are the ones who cause divisions, who are worldly and devoid of the Spirit.

jude.1.p8.b2.text: But you, beloved, by building yourselves up in your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit, keep yourselves in the love of God …

jude.1.p8.b3.text: And indeed, have mercy on those who doubt;

jude.1.p8.b4.text: save others by snatching them from the fire; …

jude.1.p9.b1.text: Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy—

jude.1.p9.b2.text: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, dominion, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord before all time, and now, and for all eternity. …
